record.name: Avalon at Mission Bay II
record.summary: Avalon at Mission Bay II, on the Assessor land parcel at 301 King St (blklot 8705011).

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705011), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 301 King St, 313 units per secondary sources, opened 2006, architect Arquitectonica. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. The parcel is condo-mapped for ownership purposes across many individually owned per-unit lots sharing this same footprint (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents one owner and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can.
